name: Cable Single-Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Stand sideways to a low pulley and reach across for its handle with the far hand.
Raise your arm out to the side and slightly forward until your elbow approaches shoulder height.
Lower your hand across the front of your thighs.
Switch sides and repeat the movement.
tips: Keep your neck relaxed and avoid leaning to start the lift.
Maintain a slight bend in your elbow and stop near shoulder height.
